Manu Ginóbili

Pronunciation: \MAN-oo jih-NOH-blee\

Emanuel David Ginóbili

(Gino, Narigon, El Contusione, Manudona, Argentina's Flying Man, Obi-Wan Ginobili)

Position: Shooting Guard ▪ Shoots: Left

6-6, 205lb (198cm, 92kg)

Born: July 28, 1977 in Bahia Blanca, Argentina ar

Draft: San Antonio Spurs, 2nd round (28th pick, 57th overall), 1999 NBA Draft

NBA Debut: October 29, 2002

Hall of Fame: Inducted as Player in 2022 (Full List)

Career Length: 16 years

Frequently Asked Questions

How old is Manu Ginóbili?

Manu Ginóbili is 49 years old.

Where was Manu Ginóbili born?

Manu Ginóbili was born in Bahia Blanca, Argentina.

When was Manu Ginóbili born?

Manu Ginóbili was born on July 28, 1977.

How tall is Manu Ginóbili?

Manu Ginóbili is 6-6 (198 cm) tall.

How much did Manu Ginóbili weigh when playing?

Manu Ginóbili weighed 205 lbs (92 kg) when playing.

Is Manu Ginóbili in the Hall of Fame?

Manu Ginóbili was inducted to the Hall of Fame as a Player in 2022 (Full List) .

When was Manu Ginóbili drafted?

Manu Ginóbili was drafted by San Antonio Spurs, 2nd round (28th pick, 57th overall), 1999 NBA Draft.

What position did Manu Ginóbili play?

Shooting Guard.

When did Manu Ginóbili retire?

Manu Ginóbili last played in 2018.

What is Manu Ginóbili's net worth?

Manu Ginóbili made at least $130,039,615 playing professional basketball.

How much did Manu Ginóbili make?

Manu Ginóbili made $14,107,492 in 2013.

What did Manu Ginóbili average?

Manu Ginóbili averaged 13.3 points, 3.5 rebounds, and 3.8 assists per game.

How many rings does Manu Ginóbili have?

Manu Ginóbili won 4 championships.

What are Manu Ginóbili's nicknames?

Gino, Narigon, El Contusione, Manudona, Argentina's Flying Man, Obi-Wan Ginobili are nicknames for Manu Ginóbili.
